CLASS zcl_words_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD words_string.
    DATA: lv_temp_string TYPE string,
          lt_split       TYPE string_table,
          lv_word        TYPE string,
          lv_pos         TYPE i,
          lv_len         TYPE i.

    lv_temp_string = iv_input_string.

    " Replace all commas with spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN lv_temp_string WITH space.

    " Remove multiple spaces
    lv_len = strlen( lv_temp_string ).
    DO lv_len TIMES.
      lv_pos = find( val = lv_temp_string sub = '  ' ).
      IF lv_pos = -1.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '  ' IN lv_temp_string WITH space.
    ENDDO.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string NO-GAPS.

    " Split by spaces
    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT space INTO TABLE lt_split.

    " Remove empty entries
    DELETE lt_split WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.

    " Process each word to handle any remaining comma cases
    LOOP AT lt_split INTO lv_word.
      IF lv_word CS ','.
        DATA(lt_comma_split) = VALUE string_table( ).
        SPLIT lv_word AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_comma_split.
        LOOP AT lt_comma_split INTO DATA(lv_comma_word).
          IF lv_comma_word IS NOT INITIAL.
            APPEND lv_comma_word TO rt_words.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Final cleanup
    DELETE rt_words WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lv_max_fills  TYPE i,

        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE ls_row TO <lv_val>.

        IF <lv_val> = 1.

        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ <dir>-col ] TO <grid_val>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        IF <grid_val> < lv_next_val.
          lv_next_val = <grid_val>.
          lv_next_row = <dir>-row.
          lv_next_col = <dir>-col.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_next_val > lv_n * lv_n.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_next_val TO lt_current_path.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_visited ASSIGNING <visited>.
      <visited>-row = lv_next_row.
      <visited>-col = lv_next_col.
      lv_min_row = lv_next_row.
      lv_min_col = lv_next_col.
      lv_steps = lv_steps + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lines( lt_current_path ) = iv_k.
      IF lt_current_path < lt_best_path.
        lt_best_path = lt_current_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_path = lt_best_path.

CLASS zcl_min_path_grid DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_grid_row TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY,
           tt_grid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_grid_row WITH DEFAULT KEY,
           tt_path TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS min_path
      IMPORTING
        it_grid        TYPE tt_grid
        iv_k           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_path) TYPE tt_path.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cell,
             row    TYPE i,
             col    TYPE i,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_cell,
           tt_cells TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cell WITH DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_neighbors
      IMPORTING
        is_cell        TYPE ty_cell
        it_grid        TYPE tt_grid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_neighbors) TYPE tt_cells.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_lex_path
      IMPORTING
        it_grid        TYPE tt_grid
        iv_k           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_path) TYPE tt_path.

    CLASS-METHODS compare_paths
      IMPORTING
        it_path1       TYPE tt_path
        it_path2       TYPE tt_path
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_less) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path_recursive
      IMPORTING
        it_grid        TYPE tt_grid
        is_current     TYPE ty_cell
        iv_steps_left  TYPE i
        it_current_path TYPE tt_path
        it_visited     TYPE tt_cells
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_min_path) TYPE tt_path.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_path_grid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD min_path.
    rt_path = find_min_lex_path( it_grid = it_grid iv_k = iv_k ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_neighbors.
    DATA: lv_rows TYPE i,
          lv_cols TYPE i,
          lv_row  TYPE i,
          lv_col  TYPE i.

    lv_rows = lines( it_grid ).
    IF lv_rows > 0.
      lv_cols = lines( it_grid[ 1 ] ).
    ENDIF.

    lv_row = is_cell-row.
    lv_col = is_cell-col.

    IF lv_row > 1.
      APPEND VALUE #( row = lv_row - 1 col = lv_col value = it_grid[ lv_row - 1 ][ lv_col ] ) TO rt_neighbors.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_row < lv_rows.
      APPEND VALUE #( row = lv_row + 1 col = lv_col value = it_grid[ lv_row + 1 ][ lv_col ] ) TO rt_neighbors.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_col > 1.
      APPEND VALUE #( row = lv_row col = lv_col - 1 value = it_grid[ lv_row ][ lv_col - 1 ] ) TO rt_neighbors.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_col < lv_cols.
      APPEND VALUE #( row = lv_row col = lv_col + 1 value = it_grid[ lv_row ][ lv_col + 1 ] ) TO rt_neighbors.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_min_lex_path.
    DATA: lt_all_cells TYPE tt_cells,
          lt_current_path TYPE tt_path,
          lt_min_path TYPE tt_path,
          lt_visited TYPE tt_cells,
          lv_rows TYPE i,
          lv_cols TYPE i,
          lv_min_value TYPE i VALUE 999999.

    lv_rows = lines( it_grid ).
    IF lv_rows > 0.
      lv_cols = lines( it_grid[ 1 ] ).
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_rows TIMES.
      DO lv_cols TIMES.
        APPEND VALUE #( row = sy-index col = sy-index value = it_grid[ sy-index ][ sy-index ] ) TO lt_all_cells.
        IF it_grid[ sy-index ][ sy-index ] < lv_min_value.
          lv_min_value = it_grid[ sy-index ][ sy-index ].
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    SORT lt_all_cells BY value.

    LOOP AT lt_all_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cell>).
      IF <fs_cell>-value > lv_min_value AND iv_k > 1.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      lt_current_path = VALUE #( ( <fs_cell>-value ) ).
      IF iv_k = 1.
        IF lt_min_path IS INITIAL OR compare_paths( lt_current_path lt_min_path ) = abap_true.
          lt_min_path = lt_current_path.
        ENDIF.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR lt_visited.
      APPEND VALUE #( row = <fs_cell>-row col = <fs_cell>-col ) TO lt_visited.
      DATA(lt_temp_path) = find_min_path_recursive(
        it_grid = it_grid
        is_current = <fs_cell>
        iv_steps_left = iv_k - 1
        it_current_path = lt_current_path
        it_visited = lt_visited
      ).

      IF lt_min_path IS INITIAL OR compare_paths( lt_temp_path lt_min_path ) = abap_true.
        lt_min_path = lt_temp_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_path = lt_min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_min_path_recursive.
    DATA: lt_local_path TYPE tt_path,
          lt_local_visited TYPE tt_cells,
          lt_neighbors TYPE tt_cells.

    lt_local_path = it_current_path.
    lt_local_visited = it_visited.

    IF iv_steps_left = 0.
      rt_min_path = lt_local_path.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_neighbors = get_neighbors( is_cell = is_current it_grid = it_grid ).

    LOOP AT lt_neighbors ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_neighbor>).
      READ TABLE lt_local_visited TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY row = <fs_neighbor>-row col = <fs_neighbor>-col.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE #( row = <fs_neighbor>-row col = <fs_neighbor>-col ) TO lt_local_visited.
      APPEND <fs_neighbor>-value TO lt_local_path.

      DATA(lt_temp_path) = find_min_path_recursive(
        it_grid = it_grid
        is_current = <fs_neighbor>
        iv_steps_left = iv_steps_left - 1
        it_current_path = lt_local_path
        it_visited = lt_local_visited
      ).

      IF rt_min_path IS INITIAL OR compare_paths( lt_temp_path rt_min_path ) = abap_true.
        rt_min_path = lt_temp_path.
      ENDIF.

      DELETE lt_local_visited INDEX lines( lt_local_visited ).
      DELETE lt_local_path INDEX lines( lt_local_path ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_paths.
    DATA: lv_min_length TYPE i.

    lv_min_length = lines( it_path1 ).
    IF lines( it_path2 ) < lv_min_length.
      lv_min_length = lines( it_path2 ).
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_min_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_val1) = it_path1[ sy-index ].
      DATA(lv_val2) = it_path2[ sy-index ].

      IF lv_val1 < lv_val2.
        rv_less = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF lv_val1 > lv_val2.
        rv_less = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF lines( it_path1 ) < lines( it_path2 ).
      rv_less = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_less = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_words_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD words_string.
    DATA: lv_temp_string TYPE string,
          lv_word        TYPE string,
          lv_pos         TYPE i.

    lv_temp_string = iv_input_string.

    " Replace commas with spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.

    " Remove multiple spaces
    lv_pos = find( val = lv_temp_string sub = '  ' ).
    WHILE lv_pos > 0.
      lv_temp_string = replace( val = lv_temp_string sub = '  ' with = ' ' occ = 1 ).
      lv_pos = find( val = lv_temp_string sub = '  ' ).
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string NO-GAPS.

    " Split by space
    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT ' ' INTO TABLE rt_words.

    " Remove any empty entries
    DELETE rt_words WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lv_pos         TYPE i.

    lv_temp_string = iv_input_string.

    " Replace all commas with spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN lv_temp_string WITH space.

    " Remove multiple spaces
    lv_len = strlen( lv_temp_string ).
    lv_pos = 1.
    WHILE lv_pos < lv_len.
      IF lv_temp_string+lv_pos(1) = space AND lv_temp_string+lv_pos+1(1) = space.
        lv_temp_string = lv_temp_string(lv_pos) && lv_temp_string+lv_pos+1.
        lv_len = lv_len - 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string NO-GAPS.

    " Split by space

    rt_words = lt_words_temp.

CLASS zcl_route_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_route_profitability.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli,
          lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_result TYPE tt_route_revenue.

    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE @lt_spfli.
    IF lt_spfli IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_spfli ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_spfli>).
      DATA(lv_revenue) = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_sflight>)
        WHERE carrid = <ls_spfli>-carrid AND connid = <ls_spfli>-connid.
        lv_revenue = lv_revenue + ( <ls_sflight>-price * <ls_sflight>-seatsocc ).
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = <ls_spfli>-cityfrom
                      cityto   = <ls_spfli>-cityto
                      revenue  = |{ lv_revenue }| ) TO lt_result.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_result BY revenue DESCENDING.

    rt_route_revenue = lt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lv_shortage TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_production_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_min_duration.
    DATA: lt_graph TYPE tt_fnet_data,
          lt_steps TYPE tt_fs_data,
          lt_in_degree TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char10 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_topological_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char10,
          lt_dist TYPE tt_dist,
          lv_max_duration TYPE i.

    lt_steps = it_fs_data.
    lt_graph = it_fnet_data.

    LOOP AT lt_steps ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_step>).
      INSERT <fs_step>-step_id INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
      INSERT VALUE #( step_id = <fs_step>-step_id dist = <fs_step>-duration ) INTO TABLE lt_dist.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_graph ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_edge>).
      INSERT <fs_edge>-to_step INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_queue) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_steps ASSIGNING <fs_step>.
      READ TABLE lt_in_degree WITH TABLE KEY table_line = <fs_step>-step_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT x = 0
                                 FOR <edge> IN lt_graph
                                 WHERE ( to_step = <fs_step>-step_id )
                                 NEXT x = x + 1 ).
      IF lv_count = 0.
        APPEND <fs_step>-step_id TO lt_queue.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      APPEND <fs_node> TO lt_topological_order.

      LOOP AT lt_graph ASSIGNING <fs_edge> WHERE from_step = <fs_node>.
        lv_count = REDUCE i( INIT x = 0
                            FOR <e> IN lt_graph
                            WHERE ( to_step = <fs_edge>-to_step )
                            NEXT x = x + 1 ).
        READ TABLE lt_steps INTO DATA(lv_step) WITH KEY step_id = <fs_edge>-to_step.
        READ TABLE lt_dist INTO DATA(lv_current_dist) WITH KEY step_id = <fs_edge>-from_step.
        IF ( lv_current_dist-dist + lv_step-duration ) > lv_max_duration.
          lv_max_duration = lv_current_dist-dist + lv_step-duration.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_dist INTO DATA(lv_existing_dist) WITH KEY step_id = <fs_edge>-to_step.
        IF ( lv_current_dist-dist + lv_step-duration ) > lv_existing_dist-dist OR sy-subrc <> 0.
          DELETE TABLE lt_dist WHERE step_id = <fs_edge>-to_step.
          INSERT VALUE #( step_id = <fs_edge>-to_step dist = lv_current_dist-dist + lv_step-duration ) INTO TABLE lt_dist.
        ENDIF.
        lv_count = lv_count - 1.
        IF lv_count = 0.
          APPEND <fs_edge>-to_step TO lt_queue.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

      READ TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <in_degree> WITH KEY step_id = <fnet>-to_step.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <in_degree>-degree = <in_degree>-degree + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <in_degree> WHERE degree = 0.
      APPEND <in_degree>-step_id TO lt_queue.
    ENDLOOP.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<queue_item>).
      lv_current_step = <queue_item>.
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.

      READ TABLE lt_graph ASSIGNING <graph_node> WITH KEY step_id = lv_current_step.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        LOOP AT <graph_node>-next_steps INTO lv_next_step.
          READ TABLE lt_max_duration ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<current_dur>) WITH KEY step_id = lv_current_step.
          READ TABLE lt_max_duration ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<next_dur>) WITH KEY step_id = lv_next_step.

          lv_temp_dur = <current_dur>-duration + <next_dur>-duration.
          IF lv_temp_dur > <next_dur>-duration.
            <next_dur>-duration = lv_temp_dur.
          ENDIF.

          READ TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <in_degree> WITH KEY step_id = lv_next_step.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <in_degree>-degree = <in_degree>-degree - 1.
            IF <in_degree>-degree = 0.
              APPEND lv_next_step TO lt_queue.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_duration = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_max_duration ASSIGNING <max_duration>.
      IF <max_duration>-duration > rv_duration.
        rv_duration = <max_duration>-duration.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_production_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_min_duration.
    DATA: lt_fs_data TYPE tt_fs_data,
          lt_fnet_data TYPE tt_fnet_data,
          lt_graph TYPE tt_fs_data,
          lt_dependencies TYPE tt_fnet_data,
          lt_in_degree TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char10 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_topological_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char10,
          lt_dist TYPE tt_dist,
          lv_max_duration TYPE i,
          lv_current_node TYPE char10,
          lv_to_node TYPE char10,
          lv_new_dist TYPE i.

    lt_fs_data = VALUE #(
      ( step_id = 'A1' description = 'Turning'     duration = 2 )
      ( step_id = 'A2' description = 'Assembling'  duration = 3 )
      ( step_id = 'A3' description = 'Milling'     duration = 1 )
      ( step_id = 'A4' description = 'Painting'    duration = 3 )
      ( step_id = 'A5' description = 'Cleaning'    duration = 1 )
      ( step_id = 'A6' description = 'Packaging'   duration = 1 ) ).

    lt_fnet_data = VALUE #(
      ( from_step = 'A1' to_step = 'A4' )
      ( from_step = 'A2' to_step = 'A4' )
      ( from_step = 'A3' to_step = 'A5' )
      ( from_step = 'A4' to_step = 'A6' )
      ( from_step = 'A5' to_step = 'A6' ) ).

    lt_graph = lt_fs_data.
    lt_dependencies = lt_fnet_data.

    LOOP AT lt_graph ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      INSERT <fs_node>-step_id INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
      INSERT VALUE #( step_id = <fs_node>-step_id value = <fs_node>-duration ) INTO TABLE lt_dist.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_dependencies ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dep>).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_in_degree[ table_line = <fs_dep>-to_step ] ).
        INSERT <fs_dep>-to_step INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_queue) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_in_degree ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_in_degree>).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_dependencies[ from_step = <fs_in_degree> ] ).
        APPEND <fs_in_degree> TO lt_queue.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INTO lv_current_node INDEX 1.
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      APPEND lv_current_node TO lt_topological_order.

      LOOP AT lt_dependencies ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_edge>) WHERE from_step = lv_current_node.
        lv_to_node = <fs_edge>-to_step.
        READ TABLE lt_dist INTO DATA(ls_from_dist) WITH KEY step_id = lv_current_node.
        READ TABLE lt_dist INTO DATA(ls_to_dist) WITH KEY step_id = lv_to_node.
        lv_new_dist = ls_from_dist-value + ls_to_dist-value.

        IF lv_new_dist > ls_to_dist-value.
          ls_to_dist-value = lv_new_dist.
          MODIFY TABLE lt_dist FROM ls_to_dist.
        ENDIF.

        DELETE TABLE lt_dependencies FROM <fs_edge>.
        IF NOT line_exists( lt_dependencies[ to_step = lv_to_node ] ).
          APPEND lv_to_node TO lt_queue.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    LOOP AT lt_dist ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dist>).
      IF <fs_dist>-value > lv_max_duration.
        lv_max_duration = <fs_dist>-value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_n            TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING
        iv_num          TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prime_fib_correct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prime_fib.
    DATA: lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_fib   TYPE f VALUE 1.0,
          lv_prev  TYPE f VALUE 0.0,
          lv_next  TYPE f.

    WHILE lv_count < iv_n.
      IF lv_fib > 1.0.
        lv_next = lv_fib + lv_prev.
        lv_prev = lv_fib.
        lv_fib = lv_next.
      ELSE.
        lv_fib = 2.0.
      ENDIF.

      IF is_prime( lv_fib ) = abap_true.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        IF lv_count = iv_n.
          rv_result = lv_fib.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    DATA: lv_i TYPE f,
          lv_sqrt TYPE f.

    IF iv_num <= 1.0.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_num = 2.0.
      rv_result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_num MOD 2.0 = 0.0.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_sqrt = sqrt( iv_num ).
    lv_i = 3.0.
    WHILE lv_i <= lv_sqrt.
      IF iv_num MOD lv_i = 0.0.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lv_i = lv_i + 2.0.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_n            TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING
        iv_num          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_num          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_root)  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prime_fib IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prime_fib.
    DATA: lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_fib   TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_prev  TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_next  TYPE i VALUE 1.

    WHILE lv_count < iv_n.
      lv_fib = lv_prev + lv_next.
      lv_prev = lv_next.
      lv_next = lv_fib.

      IF is_prime( lv_fib ) = abap_true.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        IF lv_count = iv_n.
          rv_result = lv_fib.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    IF iv_num <= 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_num = 2.
      rv_result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_num MOD 2 = 0.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lv_limit TYPE i,
          lv_i     TYPE i VALUE 3.

    lv_limit = calculate_sqrt( iv_num ).

    WHILE lv_i <= lv_limit.
      IF iv_num MOD lv_i = 0.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lv_i = lv_i + 2.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sqrt.
    DATA: lv_root TYPE f,
          lv_temp TYPE i.

    lv_root = iv_num.
    lv_temp = ( iv_num + 1 ) / 2.

    DO 20 TIMES.
      IF lv_temp = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_root = lv_temp.
      lv_temp = ( lv_root + iv_num / lv_root ) / 2.
    ENDDO.

    rv_root = lv_root.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  FINAL

CLASS zcl_check_cube IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD iscube.
    DATA: lv_cube_root TYPE f,
          lv_rounded   TYPE i,
          lv_cubed     TYPE i.

    IF a = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_cube_root = a ** ( 1 / 3 ).

    IF a > 0.
      lv_rounded = lv_cube_root + 0.5.
    ELSE.
      lv_rounded = lv_cube_root - 0.5.
    ENDIF.

    lv_rounded = FLOOR( lv_rounded ).
    lv_cubed = lv_rounded * lv_rounded * lv_rounded.

    result = boolc( lv_cubed = a ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        a                TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result)    TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_cube IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD iscube.
    DATA: lv_root TYPE i,
          lv_cube TYPE i,
          lv_sign TYPE i.

    IF a = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_sign = COND i( WHEN a > 0 THEN 1 ELSE -1 ).
    lv_root = round( val = abs( a ) ** ( 1 / 3 ) ).

    DO 3 TIMES.
      lv_cube = lv_root * lv_root * lv_root * lv_sign.
      IF lv_cube = a.
        result = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF ( lv_sign = 1 AND lv_cube > a ) OR
              ( lv_sign = -1 AND lv_cube < a ).
        lv_root = lv_root - 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_root = lv_root + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    result = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

             employee_id   TYPE char20,
             supervisor_id TYPE char20,
           END OF ty_zorg_structure.
    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: gt_zorg_structure TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_zorg_structure.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lv_ceo_count       TYPE i,
          lv_employee_count  TYPE i,
          lv_visited_count   TYPE i,
          lv_current_node    TYPE char20,
          lt_adjacency_list  TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF char20,
          lt_visited         TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lt_stack           TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lv_has_cycle       TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lt_in_degree       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_in_degree WITH UNIQUE KEY node,
          lt_employees       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_in_degree,
             node   TYPE char20,
             degree TYPE i,
           END OF ty_in_degree.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_adjacency> TYPE TABLE OF char20,
                   <fs_visited>    TYPE char20,
                   <fs_node>       TYPE char20,
                   <fs_neighbor>   TYPE char20,
                   <fs_degree>     TYPE ty_in_degree.

    gt_zorg_structure = VALUE #( ( employee_id = 'A' supervisor_id = 'B' )
                                 ( employee_id = 'B' supervisor_id = 'C' )
                                 ( employee_id = 'C' supervisor_id = 'D' ) ).

    LOOP AT gt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_zorg>).
      INSERT <ls_zorg>-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_employees.
      DATA(lv_manager_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls IN gt_zorg_structure
                                         WHERE ( employee_id = <ls_zorg>-employee_id )
                                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      IF lv_manager_count > 1.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT gt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING <ls_zorg>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_adjacency_list ASSIGNING <fs_adjacency>.
      APPEND <ls_zorg>-supervisor_id TO <fs_adjacency>.

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_in_degree[ node = <ls_zorg>-employee_id ] ).
        INSERT VALUE ty_in_degree( node = <ls_zorg>-employee_id degree = 0 ) INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
      ENDIF.

      READ TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <fs_degree> WITH TABLE KEY node = <ls_zorg>-supervisor_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_degree>-degree = <fs_degree>-degree + 1.
      ELSE.
        INSERT VALUE ty_in_degree( node = <ls_zorg>-supervisor_id degree = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_in_degree.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_ceo_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls IN lt_in_degree
                             WHERE ( degree = 0 ) NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <fs_degree> WITH TABLE KEY degree = 0.
    lv_current_node = <fs_degree>-node.

    APPEND lv_current_node TO lt_stack.
    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_node>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.

      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = <fs_node> ] ).
        lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <fs_node> TO lt_visited.

      LOOP AT lt_adjacency_list ASSIGNING <fs_adjacency>.
        LOOP AT <fs_adjacency> ASSIGNING <fs_neighbor> WHERE table_line = <fs_node>.
          APPEND <fs_neighbor> TO lt_stack.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.

      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_employees ).
    lv_visited_count = lines( lt_visited ).

    rv_result = COND #( WHEN lv_visited_count <> lv_employee_count THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             supervisor_id TYPE string,

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        it_structure TYPE tt_zorg_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS check_cycle
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee    TYPE string
        it_structure   TYPE tt_zorg_structure
        it_visited     TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string
        it_recursion   TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string
      CHANGING
        cv_has_cycle   TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lv_ceo_count  TYPE i,
          lv_employee   TYPE string,
          lv_supervisor TYPE string,
          lt_visited    TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_recursion  TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lv_has_cycle  TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    DATA(lt_structure) = it_structure.

    IF lt_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_employees.
    ENDLOOP.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_employees.

    DATA(lt_supervisors) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_structure INTO ls_entry.
      APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_supervisors.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check each employee has at most one direct manager
    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(lv_emp).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_structure INTO ls_entry WHERE employee_id = lv_emp.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        IF lv_count > 1.
          rv_result = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Find CEO (employee without supervisor)
    lv_ceo_count = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO lv_employee.
      READ TABLE lt_supervisors WITH KEY table_line = lv_employee TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        IF lv_ceo_count > 1.
          rv_result = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_supervisor = lv_employee.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for cycles and connectivity using DFS
    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_recursion.
    lv_has_cycle = abap_false.
    check_cycle(
      EXPORTING
        iv_employee  = lv_supervisor
        it_structure = lt_structure
        it_visited   = lt_visited
        it_recursion = lt_recursion
      CHANGING
        cv_has_cycle = lv_has_cycle
    ).

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if all employees are connected to CEO
    IF lines( lt_visited ) <> lines( lt_employees ).
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_cycle.
    IF it_recursion[ table_line = iv_employee ] IS NOT INITIAL.
      cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF it_visited[ table_line = iv_employee ] IS NOT INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT iv_employee INTO TABLE it_recursion.
    INSERT iv_employee INTO TABLE it_visited.

    LOOP AT it_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE supervisor_id = iv_employee.
      check_cycle(
        EXPORTING
          iv_employee  = ls_entry-employee_id
          it_structure = it_structure
          it_visited   = it_visited
          it_recursion = it_recursion
        CHANGING
          cv_has_cycle = cv_has_cycle
      ).
      IF cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DELETE TABLE it_recursion FROM iv_employee.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

           END OF ty_org_structure,

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lv_ceo_count  TYPE i,
          lv_ceo_id     TYPE char20,
          lt_visited    TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_stack      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char20,
          lv_current    TYPE char20,
          lt_children   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char20,
          lt_employee_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_org_structure WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY employee_id,
          lv_exists     TYPE abap_bool.

    IF it_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_employee_count = VALUE #( FOR ls IN it_structure
                                 ( employee_id = ls-employee_id ) ).

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_employee_count COMPARING employee_id.
    IF lines( lt_employee_count ) <> lines( it_structure ).
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_ceo_count = 0.
    LOOP AT it_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_entry1>).
      READ TABLE it_structure TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY employee_id = <ls_entry1>-supervisor_id.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = <ls_entry1>-supervisor_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_stack.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 INTO lv_current.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      lv_exists = abap_false.
      READ TABLE lt_visited WITH TABLE KEY table_line = lv_current TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_exists = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_exists = abap_false.
        INSERT lv_current INTO TABLE lt_visited.

        CLEAR lt_children.
        LOOP AT it_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_child>) WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
          APPEND <ls_child>-employee_id TO lt_children.
        ENDLOOP.

        LOOP AT lt_children INTO DATA(lv_child_id).
          lv_exists = abap_false.
          READ TABLE lt_visited WITH TABLE KEY table_line = lv_child_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_exists = abap_true.
          ENDIF.

          IF lv_exists = abap_true.
            rv_result = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ELSE.
            APPEND lv_child_id TO lt_stack.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA(lv_total_nodes) = lines( it_structure ) + 1.
    IF lines( lt_visited ) <> lv_total_nodes.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_structure TYPE tt_zorg_structure,
          lv_ceo_count TYPE i,
          lv_employee TYPE string,
          lv_supervisor TYPE string,
          lt_visited TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_stack TYPE TABLE OF string,
          lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lt_adjacency TYPE HASHED TABLE OF TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_reverse TYPE HASHED TABLE OF TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lv_connected TYPE i.

    SELECT FROM zorg_structure
      FIELDS employee_id, supervisor_id
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_structure.

    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line(
      FOR ls IN lt_structure ( CONV string( ls-employee_id ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_structure INTO DATA(ls_structure).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
        FOR ls IN lt_structure
        WHERE ( employee_id = ls_structure-employee_id )
        NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      IF lv_count > 1.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lt_adjacency = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_structure (
      CONV string( ls-employee_id ) = VALUE #( ( CONV string( ls-supervisor_id ) ) ) ) ).
    lt_reverse = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_structure (
      CONV string( ls-supervisor_id ) = VALUE #( ( CONV string( ls-employee_id ) ) ) ) ).

    lv_ceo_count = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(lv_emp).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_structure[ supervisor_id = CONV char20( lv_emp ) ] ).
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_employee = lv_emp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_stack.
    APPEND lv_employee TO lt_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 INTO lv_employee.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_employee ] ).
        lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT lv_employee INTO TABLE lt_visited.

      IF line_exists( lt_adjacency[ table_line = lv_employee ] ).
        LOOP AT lt_adjacency[ table_line = lv_employee ] INTO DATA(lv_sup).
          APPEND lv_sup TO lt_stack.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_stack.
    APPEND lv_employee TO lt_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 INTO lv_employee.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_employee ] ).
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT lv_employee INTO TABLE lt_visited.

      IF line_exists( lt_reverse[ table_line = lv_employee ] ).
        LOOP AT lt_reverse[ table_line = lv_employee ] INTO DATA(lv_sub).
          APPEND lv_sub TO lt_stack.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_connected = lines( lt_visited ).
    IF lv_connected <> lines( lt_employees ).
      result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lt_zorg_structure TYPE tt_zorg_structure,
          lv_ceo_count       TYPE i,
          lv_employee_count  TYPE i,
          lv_visited_count   TYPE i,
          lv_current_node    TYPE c LENGTH 20,
          lt_visited         TYPE TABLE OF c LENGTH 20,
          lt_stack           TYPE TABLE OF c LENGTH 20,
          lt_nodes           TYPE HASHED TABLE OF c LENGTH 20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lv_has_cycle       TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_zorg_structure.

    SELECT employee_id, COUNT( DISTINCT supervisor_id ) AS cnt
      FROM zorg_structure
      GROUP BY employee_id
      HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT supervisor_id ) > 1
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_multiple_managers).

    IF lt_multiple_managers IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_nodes = REDUCE #( INIT nodes = VALUE #( )
                         FOR entry IN lt_zorg_structure
                         NEXT nodes = VALUE #( BASE nodes ( entry-employee_id ) ( entry-supervisor_id ) ) ).

    lv_ceo_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR node IN lt_nodes
                             NEXT count = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_zorg_structure[ employee_id = node ] ) = abap_false THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ).

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_node = REDUCE #( INIT ceo = ''
                                FOR node IN lt_nodes
                                NEXT ceo = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_zorg_structure[ employee_id = node ] ) = abap_false THEN node ELSE ceo ) ).

    CLEAR: lt_visited, lt_stack.
    lv_has_cycle = abap_false.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        iv_node           = lv_current_node
        it_zorg_structure = lt_zorg_structure
      CHANGING
        ct_visited       = lt_visited
        ct_stack         = lt_stack
        cv_has_cycle     = lv_has_cycle
    ).

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_zorg_structure ).
    lv_visited_count = lines( lt_visited ).

    IF lv_visited_count <> lv_employee_count + 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    IF line_exists( ct_stack[ table_line = iv_node ] ) = abap_true.
      cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF line_exists( ct_visited[ table_line = iv_node ] ) = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT iv_node INTO TABLE ct_visited.
    INSERT iv_node INTO TABLE ct_stack.

    DATA(lt_children) = REDUCE #( INIT children = VALUE TABLE_OF( c LENGTH 20 )( )
                                  FOR entry IN it_zorg_structure
                                  WHERE ( supervisor_id = iv_node )
                                  NEXT children = VALUE #( BASE children ( entry-employee_id ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_children INTO DATA(lv_child).
      dfs(
        EXPORTING
          iv_node           = lv_child
          it_zorg_structure = it_zorg_structure
        CHANGING
          ct_visited       = ct_visited
          ct_stack         = ct_stack
          cv_has_cycle     = cv_has_cycle
      ).
      IF cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DELETE ct_stack WHERE table_line = iv_node.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_org_structure,
             employee_id   TYPE char20,
             supervisor_id TYPE char20,
           END OF ty_org_structure,
           tt_org_structure TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_org_structure WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY employee_id.

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS check_cycles_and_connectivity
      IMPORTING
        iv_node          TYPE char20
        it_org_structure TYPE tt_org_structure
      CHANGING
        ct_visited       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
        ct_rec_stack     TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_org_structure TYPE tt_org_structure,
          lv_ceo_count     TYPE i,
          lv_employee_count TYPE i,
          lv_root          TYPE char20,
          lt_visited       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_recursion_stack TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT FROM zorg_structure
      FIELDS employee_id, supervisor_id
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    " Check: Each employee has at most one direct manager
    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_org_structure ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_org_structure COMPARING employee_id.
    IF lines( lt_org_structure ) <> lv_employee_count.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check: Exactly one top-level manager (CEO)
    lv_ceo_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR entry IN lt_org_structure
                             WHERE ( supervisor_id = entry-employee_id )
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Find CEO (employee without manager or self-managed)
    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE supervisor_id = employee_id.
      lv_root = ls_entry-employee_id.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check: No cycles and all employees connected to CEO using DFS
    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_recursion_stack.

    IF check_cycles_and_connectivity(
         iv_node          = lv_root
         it_org_structure = lt_org_structure
         ct_visited       = lt_visited
         ct_rec_stack     = lt_recursion_stack ) = abap_false.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Verify all employees were visited
    IF lines( lt_visited ) <> lines( lt_org_structure ).
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_cycles_and_connectivity.
    " Mark current node as visited and add to recursion stack
    INSERT iv_node INTO TABLE ct_visited.
    INSERT iv_node INTO TABLE ct_rec_stack.

    " Find all direct reports
    LOOP AT it_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_report) WHERE supervisor_id = iv_node.
      " Check if already in recursion stack (cycle)
      IF line_exists( ct_rec_stack[ table_line = ls_report-employee_id ] ).
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      " Recursively check reports
      IF check_cycles_and_connectivity(
           iv_node          = ls_report-employee_id
           it_org_structure = it_org_structure
           ct_visited       = ct_visited
           ct_rec_stack     = ct_rec_stack ) = abap_false.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Remove from recursion stack
    DELETE TABLE ct_rec_stack FROM iv_node.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_zorg_structure TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_zorg_structure,
          lv_ceo_count       TYPE i,
          lv_employee_count  TYPE i,
          lv_root_node       TYPE c LENGTH 20,
          lt_supervisors     TYPE HASHED TABLE OF c LENGTH 20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_employees       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF c LENGTH 20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_visited         TYPE HASHED TABLE OF c LENGTH 20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_stack           TYPE TABLE OF c LENGTH 20,
          lt_connected       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF c LENGTH 20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_queue           TYPE TABLE OF c LENGTH 20.

    SELECT FROM zorg_structure
      FIELDS employee_id, supervisor_id
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_zorg_structure.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lt_zorg_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
      INSERT <entry>-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_employees.
      INSERT <entry>-supervisor_id INTO TABLE lt_supervisors.

      DATA(lv_manager_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                         FOR entry2 IN lt_zorg_structure
                                         WHERE ( employee_id = <entry>-employee_id )
                                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      IF lv_manager_count > 1.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_ceo_count = 0.
    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_employees ).

    LOOP AT lt_employees ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<emp>).
      IF line_exists( lt_supervisors[ table_line = <emp> ] ) = abap_false.
        lv_root_node = <emp>.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_stack.
    DATA(lv_has_cycle) = abap_false.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        iv_node           = lv_root_node
        it_zorg_structure = lt_zorg_structure
      CHANGING
        cv_has_cycle     = lv_has_cycle
        ct_visited       = lt_visited
        ct_stack         = lt_stack
    ).

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_connected.
    CLEAR lt_queue.
    APPEND lv_root_node TO lt_queue.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_current_node) = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.

      IF line_exists( lt_connected[ table_line = lv_current_node ] ) = abap_false.
        INSERT lv_current_node INTO TABLE lt_connected.

        LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sub>).
          IF <sub>-supervisor_id = lv_current_node.
            APPEND <sub>-employee_id TO lt_queue.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lines( lt_connected ) <> lv_employee_count.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    IF line_exists( ct_stack[ table_line = iv_node ] ) = abap_true.
      cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF line_exists( ct_visited[ table_line = iv_node ] ) = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT iv_node INTO TABLE ct_visited.
    APPEND iv_node TO ct_stack.

    LOOP AT it_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>)
      WHERE supervisor_id = iv_node.
      dfs(
        EXPORTING
          iv_node           = <entry>-employee_id
          it_zorg_structure = it_zorg_structure
        CHANGING
          cv_has_cycle     = cv_has_cycle
          ct_visited       = ct_visited
          ct_stack         = ct_stack
      ).
      IF cv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DELETE ct_stack INDEX line_index( ct_stack[ table_line = iv_node ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lv_ceo_count TYPE i,
          lv_ceo       TYPE char20.

    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE tt_zorg_structure( ).
    lt_employees = it_zorg_structure.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_employees COMPARING employee_id.
    IF lines( lt_employees ) <> lines( it_zorg_structure ).
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_ceo_count = count_ceos( it_zorg_structure ).
    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_ceo = find_ceo( it_zorg_structure ).

    IF has_cycle( it_zorg_structure ) = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF is_connected( it_zorg_structure = it_zorg_structure iv_ceo = lv_ceo ) = abap_false.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD line_exists.
    READ TABLE it_table WITH KEY table_line = iv_value TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_cycle.
    DATA: lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lt_stack   TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lv_current TYPE char20,
          lv_neighbor TYPE char20.

    LOOP AT it_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
      IF line_exists( it_table = lt_visited iv_value = <entry>-employee_id ) = abap_false.
        CLEAR: lt_stack, lt_visited.
        APPEND <entry>-employee_id TO lt_stack.

        WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
          READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ) INTO lv_current.
          DELETE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ).

          IF line_exists( it_table = lt_visited iv_value = lv_current ) = abap_true.
            rv_has_cycle = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.

          APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

          LOOP AT it_zorg_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
            lv_neighbor = ls_entry-employee_id.
            IF line_exists( it_table = lt_visited iv_value = lv_neighbor ) = abap_false.
              APPEND lv_neighbor TO lt_stack.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_ceo.
    DATA: lt_supervisors TYPE TABLE OF char20.

    lt_supervisors = VALUE #( FOR entry IN it_zorg_structure ( entry-supervisor_id ) ).

    LOOP AT it_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
      IF line_exists( it_table = lt_supervisors iv_value = <entry>-employee_id ) = abap_false.
        rv_ceo = <entry>-employee_id.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_ceos.
    DATA: lt_supervisors TYPE TABLE OF char20.

    lt_supervisors = VALUE #( FOR entry IN it_zorg_structure ( entry-supervisor_id ) ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR entry IN it_zorg_structure
      NEXT count = COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_table = lt_supervisors iv_value = entry-employee_id ) = abap_false THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_connected.
    DATA: lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lt_stack   TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lv_current TYPE char20,
          lv_neighbor TYPE char20.

    APPEND iv_ceo TO lt_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ) INTO lv_current.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ).

      IF line_exists( it_table = lt_visited iv_value = lv_current ) = abap_true.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

      LOOP AT it_zorg_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        lv_neighbor = ls_entry-employee_id.
        IF line_exists( it_table = lt_visited iv_value = lv_neighbor ) = abap_false.
          APPEND lv_neighbor TO lt_stack.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_connected = COND #( WHEN lines( lt_visited ) = lines( it_zorg_structure ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_zorg_structure TYPE tt_zorg_structure,
          lv_ceo_count       TYPE i,
          lv_employee_count  TYPE i,
          lv_connected_count TYPE i,
          lt_visited         TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lt_stack           TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lv_has_cycle       TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_current         TYPE char20,
          lv_neighbor        TYPE char20.

    lt_zorg_structure = VALUE #(
      ( employee_id = 'A' supervisor_id = 'B' )
      ( employee_id = 'B' supervisor_id = 'C' )
      ( employee_id = 'C' supervisor_id = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_employee_managers) = VALUE tt_employee_manager( ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_groups[ table_line = <entry>-employee_id ] ).
        APPEND <entry>-employee_id TO lt_groups.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_groups ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<group>).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                 FOR <e> IN lt_zorg_structure
                                 WHERE ( employee_id = <group> )
                                 NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_employee_manager( employee_id = <group> manager_count = lv_count ) TO lt_employee_managers.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_employee_managers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<em>) WHERE manager_count > 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_zorg_structure ).

    DATA(lt_supervisors) = VALUE string_table( FOR <entry> IN lt_zorg_structure ( <entry>-supervisor_id ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_supervisors.

    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE string_table( FOR <entry> IN lt_zorg_structure ( <entry>-employee_id ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_employees.

    DATA(lt_ceos) = lt_employees.
    LOOP AT lt_supervisors ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<supervisor>).
      DELETE lt_ceos WHERE table_line = <supervisor>.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_ceo_count = lines( lt_ceos ).
    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_visited = VALUE #( ).
    lt_stack = VALUE #( ( lt_ceos[ 1 ] ) ).

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<top>).
      lv_current = <top>.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current ] ).
        lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

      LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>) WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        lv_neighbor = <entry>-employee_id.
        IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_neighbor ] ).
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_neighbor TO lt_stack.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_visited = VALUE #( ).
    lt_stack = VALUE #( ( lt_ceos[ 1 ] ) ).

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <top>.
      lv_current = <top>.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current ] ).
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

      LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING <entry> WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        lv_neighbor = <entry>-employee_id.
        APPEND lv_neighbor TO lt_stack.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_connected_count = lines( lt_visited ).
    IF lv_connected_count <> lv_employee_count.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lv_current_node    TYPE char20,
          lt_adjacency_list  TYPE TABLE OF string_table,
          lt_visited         TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lt_stack           TYPE TABLE OF char20,
          lv_has_cycle       TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lt_in_degree       TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_temp            TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_zorg_structure WITH UNIQUE KEY employee_id,
          lt_employee_ids    TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_supervisor_ids  TYPE HASHED TABLE OF char20 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_nodes           TYPE TABLE OF char20.

    " Read all entries from ZORG_STRUCTURE (simulated with internal table)
    lt_zorg_structure = VALUE #(
      ( employee_id = 'A' supervisor_id = 'B' )
      ( employee_id = 'B' supervisor_id = 'C' )
      ( employee_id = 'C' supervisor_id = 'D' )
    ).

    " Check if each employee has at most one direct manager
    lt_temp = lt_zorg_structure.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_temp COMPARING employee_id.
    IF lines( lt_temp ) <> lines( lt_zorg_structure ).
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build list of all nodes
    LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_zorg>).
      INSERT <ls_zorg>-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_employee_ids.
      INSERT <ls_zorg>-supervisor_id INTO TABLE lt_supervisor_ids.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Combine all unique nodes
    lt_nodes = VALUE #( FOR ls_emp IN lt_employee_ids ( ls_emp-table_line ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_supervisor_ids ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_sup>).
      IF <ls_sup>-table_line NOT IN lt_employee_ids.
        APPEND <ls_sup>-table_line TO lt_nodes.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_employee_count = lines( lt_nodes ).

    " Initialize adjacency list and in-degree count
    LOOP AT lt_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<node>).
      INSERT VALUE string_table( ) INTO TABLE lt_adjacency_list INDEX sy-tabix.
      INSERT 0 INTO TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<in_degree>) KEY table_line = <node>.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Build adjacency list and calculate in-degrees
    LOOP AT lt_zorg_structure ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
      READ TABLE lt_adjacency_list INDEX line_index( <entry>-supervisor_id ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<adj_list>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND <entry>-employee_id TO <adj_list>.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
        FOR ls_zorg IN lt_zorg_structure
        WHERE ( supervisor_id = <entry>-employee_id )
        NEXT count = count + 1 ).

      READ TABLE lt_in_degree ASSIGNING <in_degree> KEY table_line = <entry>-employee_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <in_degree> = lv_count + lt_in_degree[ table_line = <entry>-employee_id ].
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for exactly one CEO (in-degree = 0)
    lv_ceo_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_deg IN lt_in_degree
      WHERE ( table_line = 0 )
      NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Find CEO node
    READ TABLE lt_in_degree WITH TABLE KEY table_line = 0 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_current_node = lt_in_degree[ sy-tabix ]-table_line.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for cycles using DFS
    APPEND lv_current_node TO lt_stack.
    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<top>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DELETE lt_stack INDEX 1.
        IF <top> NOT IN lt_visited.
          APPEND <top> TO lt_visited.
          lv_visited_count = lv_visited_count + 1.

          READ TABLE lt_adjacency_list INDEX line_index( <top> ) ASSIGNING <adj_list>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            LOOP AT <adj_list> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<adj>).
              IF <adj> NOT IN lt_visited.
                APPEND <adj> TO lt_stack.
              ELSE.
                lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true OR lv_visited_count <> lv_employee_count.
      rv_result = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS line_index
      IMPORTING iv_node TYPE char20
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

    DATA: lv_digits TYPE string,
          lv_length TYPE i,

      CALL FUNCTION 'STRING_REVERSE'
        EXPORTING
          string = lv_temp

CLASS zcl_circular_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD circular_shift.
    DATA: lv_digits TYPE string,
          lv_length TYPE i,
          lv_shift  TYPE i,
          lv_part1  TYPE string,
          lv_part2  TYPE string.

    lv_digits = |{ x }|.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_digits ).

    IF lv_length = 0.
      rv_result = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_shift = shift MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_shift = 0.
      rv_result = lv_digits.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_shift > lv_length.
      lv_digits = reverse( lv_digits ).
      rv_result = lv_digits.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_part1 = lv_digits+lv_length-lv_shift(lv_shift).
    lv_part2 = lv_digits(lv_length-lv_shift).
    rv_result = lv_part1 && lv_part2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reverse.
    DATA: lv_len TYPE i,
          lv_i   TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    lv_len = strlen( val ).
    result = val.

    DO lv_len / 2 TIMES.
      lv_i = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = result+lv_i(1).
      result+lv_i(1) = result+lv_len-lv_i-1(1).
      result+lv_len-lv_i-1(1) = lv_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dict_case_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lv_has_lower TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_has_upper TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_key       TYPE string.

    IF it_dict IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_dict ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
      TRY.
          lv_key = <fs_entry>-key.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          rv_result = abap_false.
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.

      IF lv_key CO lv_key.
        lv_has_upper = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lv_key CN lv_key.
        lv_has_lower = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_has_lower = abap_true AND lv_has_upper = abap_true.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dict_case_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lv_lower_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_upper_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_key         TYPE string,
          lv_first_char  TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_entry> TYPE any,
                   <lv_key>   TYPE any.

    IF it_dict IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_dict ASSIGNING <ls_entry>.
      TRY.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <ls_entry> TO <lv_key>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lv_key> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.

          lv_key = <lv_key>.
          IF lv_key IS INITIAL.
            rv_result = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.

          lv_first_char = lv_key(1).

          IF lv_first_char >= 'a' AND lv_first_char <= 'z'.
            lv_lower_count = lv_lower_count + 1.
          ELSEIF lv_first_char >= 'A' AND lv_first_char <= 'Z'.
            lv_upper_count = lv_upper_count + 1.
          ELSE.
            rv_result = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_root.
          rv_result = abap_false.
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = boolc( lv_lower_count = lines( it_dict ) OR lv_upper_count = lines( it_dict ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dict_case_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lv_lower_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_upper_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_total_keys  TYPE i,
          lt_keys        TYPE TABLE OF string.

    rv_result = abap_false.

    IF it_dict IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_dict ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dict>).
      APPEND <fs_dict>-low TO lt_keys.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_total_keys = lines( lt_keys ).

    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      IF lv_key IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF lv_key = to_lower( lv_key ).
          lv_lower_count = lv_lower_count + 1.
        ELSEIF lv_key = to_upper( lv_key ).
          lv_upper_count = lv_upper_count + 1.
        ELSE.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_lower_count = lv_total_keys OR lv_upper_count = lv_total_keys.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dict_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dict_entry,
           tt_dict TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dict_entry WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS check_dict_case
      IMPORTING
        it_dict TYPE tt_dict
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dict_case_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lv_has_lower TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_has_upper TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_has_other TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    IF it_dict IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_dict INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-key CO '0123456789'.
        lv_has_other = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        DATA(lv_upper) = ls_entry-key.
        TRANSLATE lv_upper TO UPPER CASE.
        DATA(lv_lower) = ls_entry-key.
        TRANSLATE lv_lower TO LOWER CASE.

        IF ls_entry-key = lv_upper.
          lv_has_upper = abap_true.
        ELSEIF ls_entry-key = lv_lower.
          lv_has_lower = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          lv_has_other = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_has_other = abap_true OR ( lv_has_upper = abap_true AND lv_has_lower = abap_true ).
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  FINAL

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_bracket_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_brackets.
    DATA: lv_balance TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    lv_index = 0.

    WHILE lv_index < strlen( iv_brackets ).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      lv_char = iv_brackets+lv_index-1(1).

      CASE lv_char.
        WHEN '<'.
          lv_balance = lv_balance + 1.
        WHEN '>'.
          lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.
      ENDCASE.

      IF lv_balance < 0.
        rv_result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = COND #( WHEN lv_balance = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_parens_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_nested_parens.
    DATA: lv_current_level TYPE i,
          lv_max_level     TYPE i,
          lv_char          TYPE c LENGTH 1,
          lv_group         TYPE string,
          lt_groups        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string,
          lv_length        TYPE i.

    SPLIT paren_string AT space INTO TABLE lt_groups.

    LOOP AT lt_groups INTO lv_group.
      CLEAR: lv_current_level, lv_max_level.
      lv_length = strlen( lv_group ).

      DO lv_length TIMES.
        lv_char = lv_group+sy-index(1).

        IF lv_char = '('.
          lv_current_level = lv_current_level + 1.
          IF lv_current_level > lv_max_level.
            lv_max_level = lv_current_level.
          ENDIF.
        ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
          lv_current_level = lv_current_level - 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_nested_parens_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_nested_parens.
    DATA: lv_current_level TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_max_level     TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_in_group      TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_index         TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_length        TYPE i,
          lv_char          TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    rt_levels = VALUE #( ).

    lv_length = strlen( paren_string ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_length.
      lv_char = paren_string+lv_index-1(1).

      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_current_level = lv_current_level + 1.
        IF lv_current_level > lv_max_level.
          lv_max_level = lv_current_level.
        ENDIF.
        lv_in_group = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_current_level = lv_current_level - 1.
        IF lv_current_level = 0.
          APPEND lv_max_level TO rt_levels.
          lv_max_level = 0.
          lv_in_group = abap_false.

      ELSEIF lv_char = ' ' AND lv_in_group = abap_true.
        APPEND lv_max_level TO rt_levels.
        lv_max_level = 0.
        lv_current_level = 0.
        lv_in_group = abap_false.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_in_group = abap_true.
      APPEND lv_max_level TO rt_levels.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_starts_one_ends IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD starts_one_ends.
    DATA: lv_start_with_1 TYPE i,
          lv_end_with_1 TYPE i,
          lv_both TYPE i.

    IF iv_n <= 0.
      rv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Numbers starting with 1: 1 * 10^(n-1)
    lv_start_with_1 = ipow( base = 10 exp = iv_n - 1 ).

    " Numbers ending with 1: 9^(n-1) * 1 (for first digit) * 1 (for last digit)
    " But simpler: for n-digit numbers, there are 10^(n-1) numbers ending with 1
    " (since first n-1 digits can be anything, last digit is fixed)
    lv_end_with_1 = ipow( base = 10 exp = iv_n - 1 ).

    " Numbers starting AND ending with 1: 1 * 10^(n-2) * 1
    IF iv_n > 1.
      lv_both = ipow( base = 10 exp = iv_n - 2 ).
    ELSE.
      lv_both = 1.
    ENDIF.

    " Apply inclusion-exclusion principle
    rv_count = lv_start_with_1 + lv_end_with_1 - lv_both.

    " Correction for n=1 case
    IF iv_n = 1.
      rv_count = 1.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

          lv_pos    TYPE i,
          lv_len    TYPE i,
          lv_start  TYPE i,
          lv_end    TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_decimal_to_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert.
    DATA: binary TYPE string,
          remainder TYPE i,
          number TYPE i VALUE num.

    IF number = 0.
      res = 'db0db'.
      RETURN.

    WHILE number > 0.
      remainder = number MOD 2.
      binary = |{ remainder }{ binary }|.
      number = number DIV 2.

CLASS zcl_digit_sum_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD solve.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_temp TYPE i.

    lv_temp = iv_input.

    WHILE lv_temp > 0.
      lv_sum = lv_sum + ( lv_temp MOD 10 ).
      lv_temp = lv_temp DIV 10.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = ||.
    IF lv_sum = 0.
      rv_result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_power) = 0.
    DATA(lv_highest_power) = 0.
    WHILE lv_highest_power <= lv_sum.
      lv_highest_power = 2 ** lv_power.
      lv_power = lv_power + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
    lv_power = lv_power - 2.

    WHILE lv_power >= 0.
      IF lv_sum >= 2 ** lv_power.
        rv_result = rv_result && '1'.
        lv_sum = lv_sum - ( 2 ** lv_power ).
      ELSE.
        rv_result = rv_result && '0'.
      ENDIF.
      lv_power = lv_power - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_median DEFINITION

  FINAL

      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.

CLASS zcl_median IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD median.
    DATA: lv_count TYPE i,
          lv_middle TYPE i,
          lv_value1 TYPE f,
          lv_value2 TYPE f.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sorted> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <lv_line>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_values TO <lt_sorted>.
    CREATE DATA lv_value1.
    CREATE DATA lv_value2.

    SORT <lt_sorted> BY table_line.

    lv_count = lines( <lt_sorted> ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_result = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_middle = lv_count DIV 2.

    IF lv_count MOD 2 = 1.
      ASSIGN <lt_sorted>[ lv_middle + 1 ] TO <lv_line>.
      rv_result = <lv_line>.
    ELSE.
      ASSIGN <lt_sorted>[ lv_middle ] TO <lv_line>.
      lv_value1 = <lv_line>.
      ASSIGN <lt_sorted>[ lv_middle + 1 ] TO <lv_line>.
      lv_value2 = <lv_line>.
      rv_result = ( lv_value1 + lv_value2 ) / 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS separate_paren_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_paren_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA: lv_clean_string TYPE string,
          lv_current_group TYPE string,
          lv_balance TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    " Remove spaces without using REPLACE
    lv_clean_string = iv_paren_string.
    IF lv_clean_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_temp) = ||.
      DATA(lv_pos) = 1.
      lv_length = strlen( lv_clean_string ).

      WHILE lv_pos <= lv_length.
        lv_char = lv_clean_string+lv_pos(1).
        IF lv_char <> ' '.
          lv_temp = lv_temp && lv_char.
        ENDIF.
        lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      lv_clean_string = lv_temp.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR rt_groups.
    CLEAR lv_current_group.
    CLEAR lv_balance.

    lv_length = strlen( lv_clean_string ).
    lv_pos = 1.

    WHILE lv_pos <= lv_length.
      lv_char = lv_clean_string+lv_pos(1).

      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_current_group = lv_current_group && lv_char.
        lv_balance = lv_balance + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_current_group = lv_current_group && lv_char.
        lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.

        IF lv_balance = 0.
          APPEND lv_current_group TO rt_groups.
          CLEAR lv_current_group.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS separate_paren_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_paren_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.

          lv_current_group TYPE string,
          lv_balance TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_length TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,

    " Remove all spaces from input string
    lv_temp_string = iv_paren_string.
    CLEAR lv_clean_string.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_temp_string ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_char = lv_temp_string+sy-index(1).

      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Process the cleaned string
    lv_length = strlen( lv_clean_string ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_char = lv_clean_string+sy-index(1).

      IF lv_char = '('.

        lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator DEFINITION

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA: lv_clean_string TYPE string,
          lv_current_group TYPE string,
          lv_balance TYPE i,
          lv_index TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,

    lv_clean_string = iv_paren_string.

      IF lv_char <> ' '.
        lv_temp_string = lv_temp_string && lv_char.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    DO strlen( lv_clean_string ) TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = lv_clean_string+lv_index(1).

      lv_current_group = lv_current_group && lv_char.

      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_balance = lv_balance + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.
      ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS separate_paren_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_paren_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA: lv_clean_string TYPE string,
          lv_current_group TYPE string,
          lv_balance TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    " Remove spaces by building new string character by character
    lv_clean_string = ''.
    lv_length = strlen( iv_paren_string ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_char = iv_paren_string+sy-index-1(1).
      IF lv_char <> ' '.
        CONCATENATE lv_clean_string lv_char INTO lv_clean_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    CLEAR rt_groups.
    CLEAR lv_current_group.
    lv_balance = 0.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_clean_string ).

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_char = lv_clean_string+sy-index-1(1).
      CASE lv_char.
        WHEN '('.
          lv_balance = lv_balance + 1.
          CONCATENATE lv_char lv_current_group INTO lv_current_group.
        WHEN ')'.
          lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.
          CONCATENATE lv_char lv_current_group INTO lv_current_group.
          IF lv_balance = 0.
            APPEND lv_current_group TO rt_groups.
            CLEAR lv_current_group.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

    CLASS-METHODS separate_paren_groups

CLASS zcl_paren_groups_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA: lv_clean_string TYPE string,
          lv_current_group TYPE string,
          lv_balance TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,
          lv_index TYPE i,
          lv_len TYPE i.

    " Remove spaces without using REPLACE
    lv_clean_string = iv_paren_string.
    IF lv_clean_string CS ' '.
      SPLIT lv_clean_string AT ' ' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_parts).
      CLEAR lv_clean_string.
      LOOP AT lt_parts ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<part>).
        lv_clean_string = lv_clean_string && <part>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR rt_groups.
    CLEAR lv_current_group.
    lv_balance = 0.
    lv_len = strlen( lv_clean_string ).

    DO lv_len TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = lv_clean_string+lv_index(1).

      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_balance = lv_balance + 1.
        lv_current_group = lv_current_group && lv_char.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_balance = lv_balance - 1.
        lv_current_group = lv_current_group && lv_char.

        IF lv_balance = 0.
          APPEND lv_current_group TO rt_groups.
          CLEAR lv_current_group.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_closest_pair,
             num1 TYPE f,
             num2 TYPE f,
           END OF ty_closest_pair.
    CLASS-METHODS find_closest_elements
      IMPORTING
        iv_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE ty_closest_pair.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_closest_elements IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_closest_elements.
    DATA: lt_sorted_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f,
          lv_min_diff       TYPE f VALUE '9999999999.9',
          lv_diff           TYPE f,
          lv_num1           TYPE f,
          lv_num2           TYPE f.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <num1> TYPE f,
                   <num2> TYPE f.

    lt_sorted_numbers = iv_numbers.
    SORT lt_sorted_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted_numbers ASSIGNING <num1> FROM 1.
      READ TABLE lt_sorted_numbers ASSIGNING <num2> INDEX sy-tabix + 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_diff = <num2> - <num1>.
        IF lv_diff < lv_min_diff.
          lv_min_diff = lv_diff.
          lv_num1 = <num1>.
          lv_num2 = <num2>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = VALUE #( num1 = lv_num1 num2 = lv_num2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
