             num1 TYPE string,
             num2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_number_pair.

    CLASS-METHODS find_closest_elements
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_number_pair.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      convert_to_num
        IMPORTING
          iv_value        TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_num)  TYPE decfloat16,

      convert_to_string
        IMPORTING
          iv_num          TYPE decfloat16
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_str)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_closest_elements IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_num.
    rv_num = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_to_string.
    rv_str = iv_num.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_closest_elements.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16,
          lv_min_diff TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '9999999999.99999999',
          lv_diff     TYPE decfloat16,
          lv_temp     TYPE decfloat16,
          lv_num1     TYPE decfloat16,
          lv_num2     TYPE decfloat16.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_num1> TYPE decfloat16,
                   <fs_num2> TYPE decfloat16.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_str).
      APPEND convert_to_num( lv_str ) TO lt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers ASSIGNING <fs_num1>.
      LOOP AT lt_numbers ASSIGNING <fs_num2> FROM sy-tabix + 1.
        lv_diff = <fs_num2> - <fs_num1>.
        IF lv_diff < lv_min_diff.

CLASS zcl_find_closest_elements IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_closest_elements.
    DATA: lv_min_diff TYPE f VALUE '9999999999.9999999',
          lv_diff     TYPE f,
          lv_num1     TYPE f,
          lv_num2     TYPE f,
          lt_numbers  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_val> TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_numbers ASSIGNING <lv_val>.
      APPEND CONV f( <lv_val> ) TO lt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_numbers ASCENDING.

      lv_diff = lv_current - lt_numbers[ sy-tabix - 1 ].

      IF lv_diff < lv_min_diff.
        lv_min_diff = lv_diff.
        lv_num1 = lt_numbers[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
        lv_num2 = lv_current.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_result = VALUE #( num1 = |{ lv_num1 }| num2 = |{ lv_num2 }| ).

CLASS zcl_move_one_ball IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sorted_rotated.
    DATA: lv_size TYPE i,
          lv_pivot TYPE i,
          lv_prev TYPE i,
          lv_curr TYPE i,
          lv_idx TYPE i.

    rv_valid = abap_true.

    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_size = lines( it_numbers ).
    lv_pivot = 0.

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      lv_idx = sy-index.
      lv_curr = it_numbers[lv_idx].

      IF lv_idx > 1 AND lv_curr < lv_prev.
        lv_pivot = lv_idx.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_prev = lv_curr.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_pivot > 0.
      CLEAR lv_prev.
      DO lv_size TIMES.
        lv_idx = ( sy-index - 1 + lv_pivot - 1 ) MOD lv_size + 1.
        lv_curr = it_numbers[lv_idx].

        IF sy-index > 1 AND lv_curr < lv_prev.
          rv_valid = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lv_prev = lv_curr.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    SORT lt_temp.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_temp.

      CLEAR lv_count.

        lv_count = lv_count + 1.

CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lt_unique TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_num> TYPE i.

    " First pass: count occurrences
    LOOP AT it_numbers ASSIGNING <fs_num>.
      TRY.
          lv_count = lt_count[ table_line = <fs_num> ] + 1.
          DELETE lt_count WHERE table_line = <fs_num>.
          INSERT lv_count INTO TABLE lt_count.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
          INSERT 1 INTO TABLE lt_count.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Second pass: collect numbers that appear exactly once
    LOOP AT it_numbers ASSIGNING <fs_num>.
      TRY.
          lv_count = lt_count[ table_line = <fs_num> ].
          IF lv_count = 1.
            INSERT <fs_num> INTO TABLE lt_unique.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Return results in original order
    LOOP AT it_numbers ASSIGNING <fs_num>.
      IF lt_unique[ table_line = <fs_num> ] IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND <fs_num> TO rt_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA: lv_low    TYPE f VALUE '-1000.0',
          lv_high   TYPE f VALUE '1000.0',
          lv_mid    TYPE f,
          lv_fmid   TYPE f,
          lv_f_low  TYPE f,
          lv_f_high TYPE f,
          lv_abs    TYPE f,
          lv_iter   TYPE i VALUE 1000,
          lt_coeffs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <coeff> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_coefficients ASSIGNING <coeff>.
      APPEND CONV f( <coeff> ) TO lt_coeffs.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_f_low = poly( it_coefficients = lt_coeffs iv_x = lv_low ).
    lv_f_high = poly( it_coefficients = lt_coeffs iv_x = lv_high ).

    WHILE lv_iter > 0.
      lv_mid = ( lv_low + lv_high ) / 2.
      lv_fmid = poly( it_coefficients = lt_coeffs iv_x = lv_mid ).

      lv_abs = abs( lv_fmid ).
      IF lv_abs < '0.0000001'.
        rv_zero = lv_mid.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_f_low * lv_fmid < 0.
        lv_high = lv_mid.
        lv_f_high = lv_fmid.
      ELSE.
        lv_low = lv_mid.
        lv_f_low = lv_fmid.
      ENDIF.

      lv_iter = lv_iter - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_zero = lv_mid.
  ENDMETHOD.

          lv_x_pow  TYPE f VALUE '1.0',
          lv_index  TYPE i VALUE 0.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_coeff> TYPE f.

    LOOP AT it_coefficients ASSIGNING <lv_coeff>.
      lv_sum = lv_sum + ( <lv_coeff> * lv_x_pow ).
      lv_x_pow = lv_x_pow * iv_x.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = lv_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA: lv_poly_value TYPE f,
          lv_deriv_value TYPE f,
          lv_x TYPE f VALUE 0.0,
          lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000,
          lv_iteration TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.000001.

    DATA: lt_deriv_coeff TYPE ty_coefficients.

    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO DATA(lv_coeff).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      IF lv_index > 1.
        DATA(lv_deriv_coeff) = lv_coeff * (lv_index - 1).
        APPEND lv_deriv_coeff TO lt_deriv_coeff.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    WHILE lv_iteration < lv_max_iterations.
      lv_poly_value = 0.0.
      lv_deriv_value = 0.0.
      lv_index = 0.

      LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO DATA(lv_current_coeff).
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        lv_poly_value = lv_poly_value + lv_current_coeff * (lv_x ** (lv_index - 1)).

      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_deriv_coeff INTO DATA(lv_current_deriv_coeff).

      lv_step        TYPE f VALUE 1.0,
      lv_prev_value  TYPE f,
      lv_current_value TYPE f,
      lv_sign_change TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,

      lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000,
      lv_tolerance   TYPE f VALUE '0.0000001'.

    lv_current_value = evaluate_polynomial( it_coefficients = it_coefficients iv_x = lv_x ).

    WHILE lv_iterations < lv_max_iterations.
      lv_prev_value = lv_current_value.
      lv_x = lv_x + lv_step.
      lv_current_value = evaluate_polynomial( it_coefficients = it_coefficients iv_x = lv_x ).

      IF lv_prev_value < 0 AND lv_current_value > 0 OR
         lv_prev_value > 0 AND lv_current_value < 0.
        lv_sign_change = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_iterations = lv_iterations + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_sign_change = abap_false.
      rv_zero = 0.0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_iterations = 0.
    WHILE lv_iterations < lv_max_iterations.
      DATA(lv_mid) = ( lv_x + ( lv_x - lv_step ) ) / 2.
      DATA(lv_mid_value) = evaluate_polynomial( it_coefficients = it_coefficients iv_x = lv_mid ).

      IF lv_mid_value = 0 OR lv_step < lv_tolerance.
        rv_zero = lv_mid.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_prev_value < 0 AND lv_mid_value > 0 OR
         lv_prev_value > 0 AND lv_mid_value < 0.
        lv_x = lv_mid.
        lv_current_value = lv_mid_value.
      ELSE.
        lv_x = lv_x - lv_step.
        lv_prev_value = lv_mid_value.
        lv_x = lv_mid.
        lv_current_value = evaluate_polynomial( it_coefficients = it_coefficients iv_x = lv_x ).
      ENDIF.

      lv_step = lv_step / 2.
      lv_iterations = lv_iterations + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_zero = lv_x.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA:
      lv_result TYPE f VALUE 0.0,
      lv_power  TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO DATA(lv_coeff) INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index).
      lv_power = lv_index - 1.
      lv_result = lv_result + ( lv_coeff * ( iv_x ** lv_power ) ).

    rv_result = lv_result.

        lv_balance1 = lv_balance1 + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_balance1 = lv_balance1 - 1.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_balance1 < lv_min_balance1.
        lv_min_balance1 = lv_balance1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    lv_len2 = strlen( iv_str2 ).
    lv_min_balance2 = 0.

    DO lv_len2 TIMES.
      lv_char = iv_str2+sy-index(1).
      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_balance2 = lv_balance2 + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_balance2 = lv_balance2 - 1.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_balance2 < lv_min_balance2.
        lv_min_balance2 = lv_balance2.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF ( lv_balance1 + lv_balance2 = 0 ) AND
       ( lv_min_balance1 + lv_balance2 >= 0 ) AND
       ( lv_min_balance2 + lv_balance1 >= 0 ).

    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_parentheses_matcher DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string_pair TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS match_parens
      IMPORTING
        it_strings       TYPE tt_string_pair
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parentheses_matcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD match_parens.
    DATA: lv_str1 TYPE string,
          lv_str2 TYPE string,
          lv_count1 TYPE i,
          lv_count2 TYPE i,
          lv_total_open TYPE i,
          lv_total_close TYPE i,
          lv_len1 TYPE i,
          lv_len2 TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,
          lv_index TYPE i.

    IF lines( it_strings ) <> 2.
      rv_result = 'No'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_str1 = it_strings[ 1 ].
    lv_str2 = it_strings[ 2 ].

    lv_len1 = strlen( lv_str1 ).
    lv_len2 = strlen( lv_str2 ).

    " Count parentheses in first string
    lv_count1 = 0.
    lv_index = 0.
    WHILE lv_index < lv_len1.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      lv_char = lv_str1+lv_index-1(1).
      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_count1 = lv_count1 + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_count1 = lv_count1 - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Count parentheses in second string
    lv_count2 = 0.
    lv_index = 0.
    WHILE lv_index < lv_len2.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      lv_char = lv_str2+lv_index-1(1).
      IF lv_char = '('.
        lv_count2 = lv_count2 + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_char = ')'.
        lv_count2 = lv_count2 - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Calculate total open and close parentheses
    lv_total_open = count( val = lv_str1 sub = '(' ) + count( val = lv_str2 sub = '(' ).
    lv_total_close = count( val = lv_str1 sub = ')' ) + count( val = lv_str2 sub = ')' ).

    " Check if total parentheses are balanced
    IF lv_total_open <> lv_total_close.
      rv_result = 'No'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if either combination can form a balanced string
    IF ( lv_count1 + lv_count2 = 0 ) OR
       ( lv_count1 >= 0 AND lv_count2 >= 0 ) OR
       ( lv_count1 <= 0 AND lv_count2 <= 0 AND
         ( lv_count1 + lv_count2 = 0 OR
           ( lv_count1 >= lv_count2 AND lv_count1 + lv_count2 <= 0 ) OR
           ( lv_count2 >= lv_count1 AND lv_count2 + lv_count1 <= 0 ) ) ).
      rv_result = 'Yes'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'No'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
